units: <cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 113:2">Midr. Till. to Ps. CXIII</cite> <he>לִכְלוֹת את המכה וכ׳</he> to ward this plague off from thee.

Midd. IV, 6 כֹּלֵה עֹרֵב ‘keeping off the raven’, an arrangement of iron points on the roof of the Temple; Sabb. 90ᵃ כּוֹלֵי עורב (pl.) Ms. M. (ed. כַּלְיָיא ch.; v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note); Men. 107ᵃ כולי Ms. M. (ed. כַּלְיָה); M. Kat. 9ᵃ כולי Ms. M. (ed. כליא); Arakh. 6ᵃ כליה.—Part. pass. כָּלוּי.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Nazir 2:1:3">Y. Naz. II, beg. 51ᵈ</cite> <he>כ׳ אני ממנו</he> I will be restrained from it (for ‘I will abstain’).

senses.gloss: (cmp. שלם) to be full, to be finished, to cease.
units: <cite ref="Berakhot 39a:13">Ber. 39ᵃ</cite> <he>צריך שתִּכְלֶה ברכה וכ׳</he> the benediction must be finished simultaneously with breaking the bread. Tanḥ. Ki Thissa 5 <he>כבר כָּלוּ ישראל וכ׳</he> Israel would have ceased to exist; (Pesik. Shek., p. 13ᵇ <he>חיו … מְכוּלִּין</he>, v. infra).

<cite ref="Sanhedrin 97b:14">Snh. 97ᵇ</cite> <he>כלו כל הקצין</he> all the predicted terms of redemption are ended (have passed by); a. fr.—[<cite ref="Pesikta Rabbati 12:1">Pesik. R. s. 12</cite> <he>מת וכלה בקבר</he>, read: <he>ובלה</he>.]—Part. (fr. <cite ref="K00259"><he>כּוּל</he></cite>, cmp. <cite ref="H00319"><he>חוּל</he></cite>, part. <cite ref="H00337"><he>חולות</he></cite> a. <he>חלות</he>) <cite ref="K00669"><he>כָּל</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Sanhedrin 17a:16">Snh. 17ᵃ</cite> (ref. to <he>כלאם</he>, <cite ref="Numbers 11:28">Num. XI, 28</cite>) <he>הטל … והן כָּלִין מאליהם</he> throw upon them the care for the public, and they will cease (to prophesy) of themselves; a. fr.
<cite ref="Yoma 60b:4">Yoma 60ᵇ</cite> (ref to <cite ref="Leviticus 16:20">Lev. XVI, 20</cite>) <he>אם כפר כ׳</he> when he has atoned (for the sanctuary &c.), he has finished (his task).

<cite ref="Leviticus 16:20">Ib.</cite> <he>אם כ׳ כפר</he> when he has done all (the prescribed ritual), he has achieved atonement; Sifra Aḥăré ch. IV, Par. 4; a. e.—Tanḥ. Vayetse 2 <he>מְכַלִּין את שדותיהן</he> they reap their fields entirely (leaving no corners for the poor).

<cite ref="Sanhedrin 67b:21">Snh. 67ᵇ</cite> <he>כַּלֵּה מִדַּבְּרוֹתֶיךָ ולך וכ׳</he> (some ed. <he>כלך</he>, v. Rab. D. S. a. l. note) cease from thy homiletical interpretations, and turn to &c.; <cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 136:3">Midr. Till. to Ps. CIV, 6</cite>; <cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 10:4">Ex. R. s. 10</cite>, v. <cite ref="K00750"><he>כַּלֵּךְ</he></cite>.

senses.gloss: to finish, destroy. Y. Shek. VI, 50ᵇ top (ref. to מכלות, II Chr. IV, 21) הן כִּילּוּ וכ׳ they (these vessels) consumed all the gold (of the country); Men. 29ᵃ שכִּילַּתּוֹ וכ׳ it consumed &c.
units: <cite ref="Pesikta Rabbati 2:1">Pesik. R. s. 2</cite> <he>שכי׳ אותה וכ׳</he> whom the Lord destroyed.
<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 3:3">Num. R. s. 3</cite> <he>היה הארון מְכַלֶּה בבני וכ׳</he> the Ark made havoc among the sons of Kehath (who had charge of it; cmp.

<cite ref="II Samuel 6:7">II Sam. VI, 7</cite>). Mekh. B’shall., Amalek, s. 2 <he>לכַלָּן</he> to destroy them. Y. Ḥag. II, 78ᵃ bot. (cited in Tosaf. to <cite ref="Chagigah 17b">Ḥag. 17ᵇ</cite> a. v. <cite ref="A01770"><he>אלא</he></cite>) <he>ובלבד שיְכַלֶּה עיסתו</he> (ed. <he>שיבלים</he>) provided he has used up all his dough for the day; a. fr.—Part. pass. <he>מְכוּלֶּה</he>, pl. <cite ref="M01356"><he>מְכוּלִּין</he></cite>. Pesik. Shek., p. 13ᵇ <he>כבר היו ישראל מ׳ וכ׳</he> Israel would then have been destroyed; a. e.
<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 5:8">Num. R. s. 5</cite> <he>היו מִתְכַּלִּין</he> they were diminished.
<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 5:1">Ib.</cite> <he>שלא יִתְכַּלּוּ מן וכ׳</he> that they may not be destroyed from the world.
<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 3:3">Num. R. s. 3</cite> <he>לא נ׳ וכ׳</he> not one of them was missing on being counted &c.; a. e.
